scope: Native existing-replica snapshot recovery and read-loss liveness progress; MR-10 remains IN_PROGRESS. Native nodes create durable checkpoints, pin exact retained source cuts, authenticate bounded chunk pulls over independent TLS data connections, seal images and publish only after exact durable runtime installation. Interrupted transfers abort/join/retry without blocking another group. Shutdown joins transfers and SQL owners. Configuration admission precedes catalog/member side effects. Linearizable reads retry dropped ReadIndex replies within the original invocation deadline and still require a real safe ReadIndex proof.
environment: macOS-26.5.2-arm64-arm-64bit-Mach-O; real SQLite/LTX/Raft Engine and RawNodes; three native TLS nodes/two groups; 257-byte snapshot chunks; partial response hold and interrupted retry; held/failed storage sync; seven snapshot process-kill cuts; full public Node target; ordinary storage/replication/log/domain/cell/actor regressions; checkout-specific target; no cellar_internal_tests
limitations: This does not complete MR-10 or the 17-package goal. Existing-member native lag recovery is implemented and tested; authorized replacement-member admission, live-quorum S3/peer seeding and the complete native recovery crash matrix remain. The 64-MiB incompressible image/archive fixture is a component test with an in-memory object store and mechanical image seeding; native TLS drills use small real images. Neither fixture establishes a 64-MiB SDK command envelope or physical S3 qualification. Snapshot transfer has one source and one receiver reservation per node; throughput, fairness and production capacity remain unqualified. Default generation admission requires six slots/eight image copies; explicit noncompacting snapshot-disabled profiles retain the older three-slot/four-copy floor. Archive, native recovery and stronger read behavior do not restore votes or permit quorumless writes. Blob/effect dependency closure belongs to MR-12. Process kill/injected sync failure do not establish physical power-loss behavior. No zones, production performance, larger cluster scale, federation or release qualification is claimed. Seven ignored child entry points are invoked by owning parents and excluded. Existing vendored warnings remain visible.
